name: combobox
useFor: Use to choose from a long list where typing is faster than scrolling (a merchant, a store's region). Pass items to Combobox and render ComboboxItem rows in ComboboxList, with a ComboboxInput search row. Set multiple and use ComboboxChips with ComboboxChipsInput for several values.
constraints: A combobox for under seven options (use Select)
Losing the typed text when the list closes
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the select field and the command palette)
title: Combobox
description: The select's field opening a searchable floating panel; chips in the field for several values.
